dialogues.speaker: Li the Ninth
dialogues.text: I... am Li the Ninth, a poet.

dialogues.speaker: Li the Ninth
dialogues.text: People wax lyrical about the fine food served on the Pearl Galley. But I say that the wine is best!

dialogues.speaker: Li the Ninth
dialogues.text: I've had many a cup, yet my thirst is not yet quenched. Each one is different from the last... a fine brew indeed!
